tools.name: Add board
tools.description: Creates a new Trello board; the 'name' parameter is required for creation, and various preferences can be customized or cloned from a source board.

inputs.name: desc
inputs.about: Description for the Trello board (0-16384 characters).

inputs.name: name
inputs.about: Name for the new Trello board (1-16384 characters). This field is required for board creation.

inputs.name: closed
inputs.about: Whether the board should be immediately archived (closed).

inputs.name: powerUps
inputs.about: Power-Ups to enable (e.g., 'calendar,voting', 'all'; valid: 'calendar', 'cardAging', 'recap', 'voting').

inputs.name: subscribed
inputs.about: Whether the creator is automatically subscribed to the board.

inputs.name: prefs_voting
inputs.about: Who can vote on cards ('disabled', 'members', 'observers', 'org', 'public'); corresponds to API parameter 'prefs_voting'.

inputs.name: idBoardSource
inputs.about: ID of an existing Trello board to use as a template.

inputs.name: prefs__voting
inputs.about: Who can vote on cards ('disabled', 'members', 'observers', 'org', 'public'); corresponds to API parameter 'prefs/voting'.

inputs.name: idOrganization
inputs.about: ID or name of the Trello Workspace (formerly Organization) for this board.

inputs.name: keepFromSource
inputs.about: Components to copy if 'idBoardSource' is used (e.g., 'cards,labels', 'all'; valid: 'cards', 'lists', 'checklists', 'stickers', 'members', 'customFields', 'prefs', 'labels').

inputs.name: prefs_comments
inputs.about: Who can comment on cards ('disabled', 'members', 'observers', 'org', 'public'); corresponds to API parameter 'prefs_comments'.

inputs.name: prefs_selfJoin
inputs.about: Whether Workspace members can join the board themselves; corresponds to API parameter 'prefs_selfJoin'.

inputs.name: labelNames__red
inputs.about: Name for the red label (0-16384 characters); corresponds to API parameter 'labelNames/red'.

inputs.name: prefs__comments
inputs.about: Who can comment on cards ('disabled', 'members', 'observers', 'org', 'public'); corresponds to API parameter 'prefs/comments'.

inputs.name: prefs__selfJoin
inputs.about: Whether Workspace members can join the board themselves; corresponds to API parameter 'prefs/selfJoin'.

inputs.name: prefs_cardAging
inputs.about: Card aging style ('pirate' or 'regular'); corresponds to API parameter 'prefs_cardAging'.

inputs.name: labelNames__blue
inputs.about: Name for the blue label (0-16384 characters); corresponds to API parameter 'labelNames/blue'.

inputs.name: prefs__cardAging
inputs.about: Card aging style ('pirate' or 'regular'); corresponds to API parameter 'prefs/cardAging'.

inputs.name: prefs_background
inputs.about: Board background (standard name, custom ID, or hex code; 0-16384 characters); corresponds to API parameter 'prefs_background'.

inputs.name: prefs_cardCovers
inputs.about: Whether card covers are shown; corresponds to API parameter 'prefs_cardCovers'.

inputs.name: labelNames__green
inputs.about: Name for the green label (0-16384 characters); corresponds to API parameter 'labelNames/green'.

inputs.name: prefs__background
inputs.about: Board background (standard name like 'blue', 'pink', or custom ID); corresponds to API parameter 'prefs/background'.

inputs.name: prefs__cardCovers
inputs.about: Whether card covers are shown; corresponds to API parameter 'prefs/cardCovers'.

inputs.name: prefs_invitations
inputs.about: Who can invite to the board ('admins' or 'members'); corresponds to API parameter 'prefs_invitations'.

inputs.name: labelNames__orange
inputs.about: Name for the orange label (0-16384 characters); corresponds to API parameter 'labelNames/orange'.

inputs.name: labelNames__purple
inputs.about: Name for the purple label (0-16384 characters); corresponds to API parameter 'labelNames/purple'.

inputs.name: labelNames__yellow
inputs.about: Name for the yellow label (0-16384 characters); corresponds to API parameter 'labelNames/yellow'.

inputs.name: prefs__invitations
inputs.about: Who can invite to the board ('admins' or 'members'); corresponds to API parameter 'prefs/invitations'.

inputs.name: prefs_permissionLevel
inputs.about: Board visibility and permission level ('org', 'private', 'public'); corresponds to API parameter 'prefs_permissionLevel'.

inputs.name: prefs__permissionLevel
inputs.about: Board visibility and permission level ('org', 'private', 'public'); corresponds to API parameter 'prefs/permissionLevel'.

inputs.name: prefs__calendarFeedEnabled
inputs.about: Whether the calendar feed is enabled; corresponds to API parameter 'prefs/calendarFeedEnabled'.

tools.name: Add new list to board (Deprecated)
tools.description: DEPRECATED: Use TRELLO_LIST_CREATE_LIST instead. Creates a new, empty list on a specified, existing Trello board, typically used as a column or category for organizing cards.

inputs.name: pos
inputs.about: The position of the new list on the board. Valid values are 'top', 'bottom', or a positive number (e.g., 1, 2.5, 3). If not provided, the list is added to the bottom.

inputs.name: name
inputs.about: The name for the new list. Must be a string with a length from 1 to 16384 characters.

inputs.name: idBoard
inputs.about: The ID of the board to which the new list will be added.

tools.name: Add card
tools.description: Creates a new card in a Trello list. Only `idList` is required; `idBoard` is optional as the API determines the board from the list.

inputs.name: due
inputs.about: Due date for the card (date string or 'null' to remove).

inputs.name: pos
inputs.about: Position in list: 'top', 'bottom', or a positive float.

inputs.name: desc
inputs.about: Card description (0-16384 characters).

inputs.name: name
inputs.about: Name/title for the card. Highly recommended for new cards. If omitted, a blank title is created. When using 'idCardSource' to copy a card, the name is copied from the source unless overridden here.

inputs.name: closed
inputs.about: Archive (close) the card. Valid values: 'true', 'false'.

inputs.name: idList
inputs.about: ID of the list to add the card to. Must be a 24-character hexadecimal string.

inputs.name: idBoard
inputs.about: ID of the board for the card. Must be a 24-character hexadecimal string. Optional - the API automatically determines the board from idList.

inputs.name: idLabels
inputs.about: Comma-separated list of label IDs to add. Each ID must be a 24-character hexadecimal string.

inputs.name: idMembers
inputs.about: Comma-separated list of member IDs to assign. Each ID must be a 24-character hexadecimal string.

inputs.name: urlSource
inputs.about: URL to attach to the card. If a Trello card URL is provided, the card is copied from that source. Use 'null' or omit if not needed.

inputs.name: fileSource
inputs.about: Binary data of a file to attach.

inputs.name: subscribed
inputs.about: Subscribe user to the card. Valid values: 'true', 'false'.

inputs.name: idCardSource
inputs.about: ID of an existing card to copy. Must be a 24-character hexadecimal string. When provided, the new card inherits name and other properties from the source card.

inputs.name: keepFromSource
inputs.about: If using `idCardSource`, properties to copy: 'all' or comma-separated (e.g., 'attachments', 'checklists', 'due').

inputs.name: idAttachmentCover
inputs.about: ID of an image attachment on this card for its cover, or 'null' for no cover. Must be a 24-character hexadecimal string or 'null'.

tools.name: Add comment to card
tools.description: Adds a new text comment, which can include @mentions, to a Trello card specified by its ID; file attachments are not supported via this action.

inputs.name: text
inputs.about: Comment text, between 1 and 16384 characters. Supports @mentions to notify Trello users.

inputs.name: idCard
inputs.about: ID or shortLink of the Trello card to add the comment to.

tools.name: Add attachment to card
tools.description: Adds an attachment to a Trello card by `idCard`; specify either a `file` to upload or a `url` to link, but not both.

inputs.name: url
inputs.about: URL of an external resource to attach if not uploading a `file`. Must start with 'http://' or 'https://'.

inputs.name: file
inputs.about: Path to the local file to attach if not linking a `url`.

inputs.name: name
inputs.about: Desired name for the attachment. If omitted, Trello uses the original filename or a URL-derived default. Max length 256.

inputs.name: idCard
inputs.about: ID or shortLink of the Trello card.

inputs.name: mimeType
inputs.about: MIME type of the attachment, aiding Trello in file handling. Max length 256.

tools.name: Add checklist to card via id
tools.description: Adds a checklist to a Trello card: use `value` to add a specific existing checklist, `idChecklistSource` to create a new checklist by copying an existing one (optionally using `name` for the new checklist's name), or `name` to create a new empty checklist from scratch.

inputs.name: name
inputs.about: The name for the new checklist. Used when creating a new checklist from scratch or when copying from `idChecklistSource`. If `value` specifies an existing checklist ID to add, this `name` is ignored. String with a length from 0 to 16384 characters.

inputs.name: value
inputs.about: The ID of a pre-existing checklist to add directly to the card. If an ID is provided here, that specific checklist is added. If `null` or omitted, a new checklist will be created on the card (either empty using `name`, or by copying from `idChecklistSource`).

inputs.name: idCard
inputs.about: The ID or shortLink of the card to which the checklist will be added.

inputs.name: idChecklistSource
inputs.about: The ID of an existing checklist to copy. If provided (and `value` is not an ID of an existing checklist to add), a new checklist is created on the card by duplicating this source checklist. The `name` parameter can be used to specify a name for the newly created checklist.

tools.name: Add label to card
tools.description: Adds an existing label to a Trello card; `idCard` identifies the card and `value` is the ID of the label to add. Both card and label must already exist.

inputs.name: value
inputs.about: The ID of the label to add. Label IDs are typically 24-character hexadecimal strings.

inputs.name: idCard
inputs.about: The ID or shortLink of the Trello card. Card IDs are typically 24-character hexadecimal strings.

tools.name: Add member vote to card
tools.description: Casts a 'yes' vote for a specified member on a Trello card; a member can only vote once per card.

inputs.name: value
inputs.about: The ID of the member to cast a 'yes' vote on the card. Must be a valid 24-character member ID. Note: Voting must be enabled on the board for this action to succeed.

inputs.name: idCard
inputs.about: The ID of the card to add the vote to. Must be the full 24-character card ID, not a short link. For example, `571d07b591c8b68aeb4f6acc`.

tools.name: Add check item to checklist (Deprecated)
tools.description: DEPRECATED: Use TRELLO_ADD_CHECKLISTS_CHECK_ITEMS_BY_ID_CHECKLIST instead. Adds a new check item to an existing checklist on a specific Trello card.

inputs.name: pos
inputs.about: The position of the new check item within the checklist. Valid values are 'top', 'bottom', or a positive number (e.g., '1', '2.5').

inputs.name: name
inputs.about: The name of the check item to be created. Must be a string with a length between 1 and 16384 characters.

inputs.name: idCard
inputs.about: The ID or short link of the card where the checklist resides.

inputs.name: idChecklist
inputs.about: The ID of the checklist to which the new check item will be added.

tools.name: Add checklist to card
tools.description: Creates a new checklist on a Trello card, either by name or by copying from `idChecklistSource`, targeting an `idCard` or `idBoard`; this action creates only the checklist structure, not its items.

inputs.name: pos
inputs.about: The position of the new checklist on its card. Accepted values are 'top', 'bottom', or a positive number (integer or float).

inputs.name: name
inputs.about: The name for the new checklist. Required if `idChecklistSource` is not provided. Must be a string with length between 0 and 16384 characters.

inputs.name: idCard
inputs.about: The ID of the Trello card to which the checklist will be added. If provided, the checklist is added to this specific card. One of `idBoard` or `idCard` is required.

inputs.name: idBoard
inputs.about: The ID of the Trello board. If `idCard` is not specified, this board will be targeted, potentially for creating a new card to host the checklist. One of `idBoard` or `idCard` is required.

inputs.name: idChecklistSource
inputs.about: The ID of an existing checklist to be copied. If provided, the `name` parameter is ignored, and the new checklist will be a duplicate of this source.

tools.name: Add check item to checklist
tools.description: Adds a new check item to a specified Trello checklist; this action does not update existing check items.

inputs.name: pos
inputs.about: Position for the new check item: 'top', 'bottom', or a positive number. Defaults to bottom.

inputs.name: name
inputs.about: Name/title for the new check item (1-16384 characters). Required by the Trello API for successful creation.

inputs.name: checked
inputs.about: Initial completion status: 'true' or 'false'. Defaults to unchecked.

inputs.name: idChecklist
inputs.about: ID of the checklist to add the new check item to.

tools.name: Create label on board
tools.description: Creates a new label with a specified name (required) and color on a Trello board (idBoard required); this action defines the label but does not apply it to cards.

inputs.name: name
inputs.about: Name for the new label (0-16384 characters). **Required by the Trello API.** An empty string creates a color-only visual label.

inputs.name: color
inputs.about: Color for the new label. Valid values: green, yellow, orange, red, purple, blue, sky, lime, pink, black (and their _dark/_light variants). If not specified, the label will have no color (color=null).

inputs.name: idBoard
inputs.about: ID of the board for the new label. Must be a 24-character hexadecimal TrelloID (e.g., '60d5f2d97f5f8c008d3e9d6b'). Note: The 8-character shortLink from board URLs is NOT accepted by this endpoint. Required by the Trello API.

tools.name: Add new list to board
tools.description: Creates a new list on a specified Trello board, with options to copy an existing list, set its position, initial state (archived/subscribed), and does not modify existing lists or move cards.

inputs.name: pos
inputs.about: The position of the new list on the board. Valid values are `top`, `bottom`, or a positive number (e.g., '1', '2.5').

inputs.name: name
inputs.about: The name for the new list. Must be a string with a length from 1 to 16384 characters. This is a required parameter.

inputs.name: closed
inputs.about: Indicates whether the list should be created as closed (archived). Set to `true` for closed, or `false` for open.

inputs.name: idBoard
inputs.about: The ID of the board to which the new list should be added. This is a required parameter.

inputs.name: subscribed
inputs.about: Indicates whether the user creating the list should be automatically subscribed to it. Set to `true` to subscribe, or `false` otherwise.

inputs.name: idListSource
inputs.about: The ID of an existing list to copy when creating the new list. If provided, the new list will be a copy of this source list.

tools.name: Add card to list (Deprecated)
tools.description: DEPRECATED: Use TRELLO_CARD_CREATE_AND_UPDATE instead. Creates a new card in a Trello list, which must be specified by an existing and accessible `idList`.

inputs.name: due
inputs.about: The due date for the new card, in ISO 8601 format (e.g., 'YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS.SSSZ') or null if no due date is set.

inputs.name: desc
inputs.about: The description for the new card. A string with a length from 0 to 16384 characters.

inputs.name: name
inputs.about: The name/title for the new card. Required. A non-empty string with a length from 1 to 16384 characters.

inputs.name: idList
inputs.about: The ID of the Trello list where the new card will be created.

inputs.name: labels
inputs.about: A comma-separated list of label colors to apply to the card. Valid colors: blue, green, orange, purple, red, yellow. Alternatively, 'all' can be used to apply all available label colors on the board.

inputs.name: idMembers
inputs.about: A comma-separated list of member IDs (24-character hex strings) to assign to the new card.

tools.name: Add card member by id
tools.description: Assigns a Trello member to a specific Trello card by card ID (or short link) and member ID.

inputs.name: value
inputs.about: The ID of the Trello member to be added to the card.

inputs.name: idCard
inputs.about: The ID or short link of the Trello card to which the member will be added.

tools.name: Archive all cards in list
tools.description: Archives all cards in a Trello list; while cards can be restored via the Trello interface, this action does not provide an unarchive function.

inputs.name: idList
inputs.about: The unique identifier of the Trello list from which all cards will be archived.

tools.name: Convert checklist item to card
tools.description: Converts a checklist item into a new card (useful for promoting a subtask), which inherits some properties from the item; this is irreversible via the API and offers no customization during conversion.

inputs.name: idCard
inputs.about: The ID or short link of the card containing the checklist and the item to be converted.

inputs.name: idCheckItem
inputs.about: The ID of the checklist item that will be converted into a new card.

inputs.name: idChecklist
inputs.about: The ID of the checklist that contains the specific item to be converted to a card.

tools.name: Add reaction to action
tools.description: Tool to add a new emoji reaction to a Trello action. Use when acknowledging comments or actions with reactions.

inputs.name: native
inputs.about: The emoji to add as a native unicode emoji.

inputs.name: unified
inputs.about: The unified value of the emoji to add.

inputs.name: idAction
inputs.about: The ID of the action to add a reaction to.

inputs.name: shortName
inputs.about: The primary shortName of the emoji to add (e.g., '+1', 'heart', 'thumbsup'). See Trello emoji documentation for available emojis.

inputs.name: skinVariation
inputs.about: The skin variation of the emoji to add.

tools.name: Add a label to a board
tools.description: Creates a new label on an existing Trello board.

inputs.name: name
inputs.about: The name for the new label. Must be a string with a length from 0 to 16384 characters. An empty string is allowed.

inputs.name: color
inputs.about: The color for the new label. Provide a valid Trello label color name or null for no color. If not provided, Trello may assign a default color or no color.

inputs.name: idBoard
inputs.about: The ID of the board to which the new label will be added.

tools.name: Add labels to card
tools.description: Adds a label to an existing Trello card (specified by `idCard`), defining the label by `name` and either `color` or the overriding `value` (which specifies color by name); a new label is created on the board if a matching one (by name/color combination) doesn't already exist.

inputs.name: name
inputs.about: Name for the label (0-16384 chars). If a label with this name exists on the board, it will be reused; otherwise, a new label with this name and specified color is created and added to the card.

inputs.name: color
inputs.about: Label color name. Valid colors: green, yellow, orange, red, purple, blue, sky, lime, pink, black, or null for no color. Used if 'value' is not provided.

inputs.name: value
inputs.about: Alternative way to specify label color by name. When using 'all', adds all default board labels to the card. Overrides 'color' parameter if both are provided.

inputs.name: idCard
inputs.about: ID or shortlink of the card.

tools.name: Add sticker to card
tools.description: Adds a sticker to a Trello card, using a default sticker name (e.g., 'taco-cool') or a custom sticker ID for the image, and allows specifying its position, rotation, and z-index.

inputs.name: top
inputs.about: Vertical offset from card's top edge (pixels). Uses default position if omitted.

inputs.name: left
inputs.about: Horizontal offset from card's left edge (pixels). Uses default position if omitted.

inputs.name: image
inputs.about: Name of a default Trello sticker (e.g., 'taco-cool'), ID of a previously uploaded custom sticker. Length: 0-16384 chars. Uses default if omitted.

inputs.name: idCard
inputs.about: ID or short link of the card.

inputs.name: rotate
inputs.about: Rotation angle in degrees; positive rotates clockwise. Defaults to 0 if omitted.

inputs.name: zIndex
inputs.about: Stacking order (z-index); higher values are on top. Must be an integer. Trello assigns a default layer if omitted.

tools.name: Create custom field
tools.description: Create a custom-field definition on a Trello board.

inputs.name: pos
inputs.about: The field position as a numeric value, 'top', or 'bottom'.

inputs.name: name
inputs.about: The name displayed for the custom field.

inputs.name: type
inputs.about: The value type of the custom field.

inputs.name: idModel
inputs.about: The 24-character hexadecimal ID of the board that owns the custom field.

inputs.name: options
inputs.about: Initial dropdown options. Use only when type is 'list'.

inputs.name: displayCardFront
inputs.about: Whether Trello displays the custom field on card fronts.

tools.name: Add member board background
tools.description: Adds a new custom board background, from an image file, to a specified Trello member's collection, making it available for their use but not applying it to any board.

inputs.name: file
inputs.about: The image file to be uploaded for the board background. This is typically a file path or a URL accessible by the system performing the upload.

inputs.name: tile
inputs.about: Determines whether the background image should be tiled. Set to 'true' to tile the image or 'false' to display it as a single image.

inputs.name: idMember
inputs.about: The ID or username of the Trello member.

inputs.name: brightness
inputs.about: Specifies the brightness of the background. Valid values are 'dark', 'light', or 'unknown'.

tools.name: Add board star to member
tools.description: Stars a Trello board for a member at a specified position; the board must exist and be accessible to the member.

inputs.name: pos
inputs.about: The desired position for the new board star in the member's list of starred boards. Valid values are 'top', 'bottom', or a positive integer.

inputs.name: idBoard
inputs.about: The ID of the Trello board to be starred. The board must exist and be accessible to the specified member.

inputs.name: idMember
inputs.about: The ID or username of the Trello member for whom the board star will be added.

tools.name: Add custom board background for a member
tools.description: Adds a custom board background for a specified Trello member using either an image file or an external image URL, but not both.

inputs.name: url
inputs.about: URL of an external image to use as the custom board background. Must start with 'http://' or 'https://'. Either 'file' or 'url' must be provided.

inputs.name: file
inputs.about: The image file to upload as the custom board background. Supported formats: PNG, JPEG, GIF. Either 'file' or 'url' must be provided.

inputs.name: tile
inputs.about: Indicates whether the custom board background image should be tiled. Set to 'true' to enable tiling, or 'false' to disable it.

inputs.name: idMember
inputs.about: The ID or username of the Trello member for whom the custom board background will be added.

inputs.name: brightness
inputs.about: Specifies the brightness setting for the custom board background. Accepted values are 'dark', 'light', or 'unknown'.

tools.name: Add custom emoji for a member
tools.description: Adds a new custom emoji using an image file and a unique name to a Trello member's account; this emoji is member-specific and not shared across the workspace.

inputs.name: file
inputs.about: Emoji image file to upload. Must adhere to Trello's image format and size guidelines. Sent as multipart/form-data.

inputs.name: name
inputs.about: Unique name for the custom emoji (2-64 characters).

inputs.name: idMember
inputs.about: ID or username of the member.

tools.name: Add custom sticker for member
tools.description: Uploads a custom sticker to a Trello member's collection, if the member's plan allows custom stickers and respects associated limits.

inputs.name: file
inputs.about: The sticker image file to upload. Trello recommends images to be 128x128 pixels for optimal display. Supported formats: PNG, JPG, GIF.

inputs.name: idMember
inputs.about: The ID or username of the Trello member to whom the custom sticker will be added. Use 'me' for the authenticated member.

tools.name: Add saved search for member
tools.description: Creates a new saved search with a specified name, position, and query for a Trello member.

inputs.name: pos
inputs.about: The position of the saved search in the member's list of saved searches. Can be 'top', 'bottom', or a positive numerical value.

inputs.name: name
inputs.about: The name for the saved search. Must be a non-empty string with at least one non-space character.

inputs.name: query
inputs.about: The search query string to be saved. The string must have a length between 1 and 16384 characters.

inputs.name: idMember
inputs.about: The ID or username of the Trello member for whom the saved search will be created.

tools.name: Create organization
tools.description: Creates a new Trello organization (Workspace) with a `displayName` (required), and optionally a description, website, and various preferences (e.g., board visibility, member invitation restrictions).

inputs.name: desc
inputs.about: The description for the organization. Max length: 16384 characters.

inputs.name: name
inputs.about: The unique, URL-friendly programmatic name for the organization. Must be lowercase, start with a letter, and contain only lowercase letters, numbers, and underscores. Max length: 16384 characters. If not provided, Trello will generate one based on the displayName.

inputs.name: website
inputs.about: The URL of the organization's website. Must start with 'http://' or 'https://'. Can be null or an empty string if no website.

inputs.name: displayName
inputs.about: The human-readable name for the organization. Min length: 1 character. Cannot begin or end with a space. This field is required.

inputs.name: prefs__permissionLevel
inputs.about: The default permission level for new boards created within the organization. Allowed values: 'private' or 'public'.

inputs.name: prefs__associatedDomain
inputs.about: The Google Workspace (formerly G Suite) domain to associate with the organization. This enables features like restricting membership to users from this domain.

inputs.name: prefs__googleAppsVersion
inputs.about: The version of Google Workspace integration. Allowed values: '1' or '2'.

inputs.name: prefs__orgInviteRestrict
inputs.about: Specifies restrictions on who can be invited to the organization, e.g., a comma-separated list of email domains ('@example.com,@mycompany.com') or specific email addresses. If not set, any Trello user can be invited.

inputs.name: prefs__externalMembersDisabled
inputs.about: Determines if external members (guests) are disabled for the organization. Set to 'true' to disable, 'false' to enable.

inputs.name: prefs__boardVisibilityRestrict__org
inputs.about: Controls creation of organization-visible boards. Allowed values: 'admin' (only admins can create), 'none' (cannot be created), 'org' (any member can create).

inputs.name: prefs__boardVisibilityRestrict__public
inputs.about: Controls creation of public boards. Allowed values: 'admin' (only admins can create), 'none' (cannot be created), 'org' (any member can create).

inputs.name: prefs__boardVisibilityRestrict__private
inputs.about: Controls creation of private boards. Allowed values: 'admin' (only admins can create), 'none' (cannot be created), 'org' (any member can create).

tools.name: Create new session
tools.description: Creates or updates a Trello user session, optionally linking it to a specific board for status updates and setting the user's activity status.

inputs.name: status
inputs.about: Sets the user's current activity status for the session.

inputs.name: idBoard
inputs.about: The ID of the Trello board to associate with this session for status updates.

tools.name: Create webhook
tools.description: Tool to create a new Trello webhook for monitoring changes to a board, card, list, or member. Use when you need to set up real-time notifications for model changes. The callback URL must be publicly accessible and respond to HEAD requests for validation.

inputs.name: active
inputs.about: Determines whether the webhook is active and sending POST requests. Defaults to true if not specified.

inputs.name: idModel
inputs.about: ID of the model (board, card, list, or member) to be monitored by the webhook.

inputs.name: callbackURL
inputs.about: A valid URL that is reachable with a HEAD and POST request. This is where Trello will send webhook notifications.

inputs.name: description
inputs.about: A description for the webhook (0-16384 characters).

tools.name: Delete action by id
tools.description: Deletes a specific Trello action, such as a `commentCard`, by its ID; this is an irreversible operation and only applies to deletable action types, as many (especially system-generated) actions cannot be deleted.

inputs.name: idAction

IMPORTANT LIMITATIONS: - Search indexing has a delay: newly created/updated cards may not appear for several minutes. - For exact name matching or time-sensitive lookups, use TRELLO_GET_LISTS_CARDS_BY_ID_LIST or TRELLO_GET_BOARDS_CARDS_BY_ID_BOARD to enumerate cards directly, then filter by name. - The search uses word tokenization: queries like 'Payment failed when sending tips' are split into individual terms ['Payment', 'failed', 'when', 'sending', 'tips']. Common words may be ignored. - Set partial='true' (default) for better recall with prefix matching on the last search term.

inputs.name: query
inputs.about: The search query string. Trello tokenizes the query into individual words and searches for cards/boards/etc. containing those terms. Note: Common words like 'when', 'the', 'is' may be ignored as stop words.

inputs.name: idCards
inputs.about: A comma-separated list of card IDs to search for. Each card ID must be a 24-character hexadecimal string (e.g., '5f9f1b9b8f8f8f8f8f8f8f8f'). Do NOT use the short card ID from the card URL.

inputs.name: partial
inputs.about: Enable partial/prefix matching for search terms ('true' or 'false'). Default is 'true'. When true, the last word in the query will match word prefixes (e.g., 'pay' matches 'payment'). When false, only exact word matches are returned. Setting to 'true' (recommended) improves search recall, especially

inputs.name: idBoards
inputs.about: A comma-separated list of board IDs to search within, or 'mine' to search all boards the user is a member of (default). Each board ID must be a 24-character hexadecimal string (e.g., '5f9f1b9b8f8f8f8f8f8f8f8f'). Do NOT use the short 8-character ID from the board URL (e.g., 'VGflYpta' from 'trello.co

inputs.name: card_list
inputs.about: Whether to include the list object for each card returned ('true' or 'false').

inputs.name: card_board
inputs.about: Whether to include the board object for each card returned ('true' or 'false').

inputs.name: cards_page
inputs.about: Page number for paginated card results. Must be 0-100. Default is 0.

inputs.name: modelTypes
inputs.about: Types of Trello objects to search (e.g., 'cards,boards' or 'all' from 'actions', 'boards', 'cards', 'members', 'organizations'). Default is 'all'.

inputs.name: card_fields
inputs.about: Fields for found cards; 'all' or a comma-separated list (e.g., 'name,due'). Default is 'all'.

inputs.name: cards_limit
inputs.about: Maximum number of card results (1-1000). Use 0 to exclude cards from search results. Default is 10.

inputs.name: board_fields
inputs.about: Fields for found boards; 'all' or a comma-separated list (e.g., 'name,url'). Default is 'name,idOrganization'.

inputs.name: boards_limit
inputs.about: Maximum number of board results (1-1000). Use 0 to exclude boards from search results. Default is 10.

inputs.name: card_members
inputs.about: Whether to include member objects for each card returned ('true' or 'false').

inputs.name: card_stickers
inputs.about: Whether to include sticker objects for each card returned ('true' or 'false').

inputs.name: member_fields
inputs.about: Fields for found members; 'all' or a comma-separated list (e.g., 'fullName,username'). Default is 'avatarHash,fullName,initials,username,confirmed'.

inputs.name: members_limit
inputs.about: Maximum number of member results (1-1000). Use 0 to exclude members from search results. Default is 10.

inputs.name: idOrganizations
inputs.about: A comma-separated list of organization (workspace) IDs to search within. Each organization ID must be a 24-character hexadecimal string (e.g., '5f9f1b9b8f8f8f8f8f8f8f8f').

inputs.name: card_attachments
inputs.about: Whether to include attachments for cards ('true', 'false', or 'cover' for card cover attachments).

inputs.name: organization_fields
inputs.about: Fields for found organizations; 'all' or a comma-separated list (e.g., 'name,url'). Default is 'name,displayName'.

inputs.name: organizations_limit
inputs.about: Maximum number of organization results (1-1000). Use 0 to exclude organizations from search results. Default is 10.

tools.name: Search for members
tools.description: Searches Trello members by name, username, or email, optionally scoped to a board or organization.

inputs.name: limit
inputs.about: Maximum number of member records to return (string '1'-'20'). Default is 8.

inputs.name: query
inputs.about: Search query for Trello members by name, username, or email (1-16384 characters).

inputs.name: idBoard
inputs.about: Optional board ID to scope the search to members relevant to that board.

inputs.name: idOrganization
inputs.about: Optional organization/workspace ID to scope the search to that organization.

inputs.name: onlyOrgMembers
inputs.about: When 'true' and idOrganization is provided, only return members of that organization. Values: 'true' or 'false'.

tools.name: Get sessions socket
tools.description: Requests Trello WebSocket session connection information for real-time updates. Trello webhooks are an alternative for receiving updates.

tools.name: Get token by token
tools.description: Retrieves information about the authenticated Trello API token. You can select token fields and request associated webhook information; the supplied token parameter does not select a different token.

inputs.name: token
inputs.about: The Trello API token string to query. Must be the full token value (e.g., 'ATTA...').

inputs.name: fields
inputs.about: Comma-separated string of fields to include (e.g., 'dateCreated,idMember') or 'all'. Valid fields: 'dateCreated', 'dateExpires', 'idMember', 'identifier', 'permissions'.

inputs.name: webhooks
inputs.about: String 'true' or 'false' to include webhook information.

tools.name: Get token field
tools.description: Retrieves a specific field from the current Trello API token, using the token in authentication metadata.

inputs.name: field
inputs.about: The specific field of the token to retrieve (e.g., 'identifier', 'idMember', 'dateCreated', 'dateExpires', 'permissions').

tools.name: Get token member
tools.description: Retrieves information about the Trello member associated with the current API token, allowing customization of the returned fields.

inputs.name: fields
inputs.about: Specifies the member fields to return. Use 'all' for all fields, or a comma-separated list of specific field names. Available fields: avatarHash, avatarSource, bio, bioData, confirmed, email, fullName, gravatarHash, idBoards, idBoardsPinned, idOrganizations, idPremOrgsAdmin, initials, loginTypes, me

tools.name: Retrieve token member field
tools.description: Retrieves a specific field for the Trello member associated with the current API token. The token is automatically extracted from authentication, so only the field name needs to be specified.

inputs.name: field
inputs.about: The specific member field to retrieve. Valid fields include: id, username, fullName, email, avatarHash, avatarUrl, avatarSource, bio, bioData, confirmed, initials, memberType, activityBlocked, idBoards, idBoardsPinned, idOrganizations, idPremOrgsAdmin, idEnterprise, idEnterprisesDeactivated, idMembe

tools.name: Get webhooks for token
tools.description: Retrieves webhooks associated with the current Trello API token, extracted from authentication metadata.

tools.name: Get token webhook by ID
tools.description: Retrieves details of a Trello webhook by ID, scoped to the current API token extracted from authentication metadata.

inputs.name: idWebhook
inputs.about: The unique identifier (ID) of the webhook whose details are to be retrieved. This ID is typically a 24-character hexadecimal string.

tools.name: Get type by id
tools.description: Identifies the type of a Trello resource (member or organization) given its ID. Returns a 'type' field indicating whether the resource is a 'member' or 'organization'. Note: This endpoint only works for members and organizations; boards, cards, and lists are not supported.

inputs.name: id
inputs.about: The ID of a Trello resource (member or organization) to identify its type. Use 'me' for the current authenticated user, a member ID (24-character hex string), or an organization ID.

tools.name: Get webhook by ID
tools.description: Retrieves the full configuration and status for a specific Trello webhook by its unique ID; this action does not return past notification history.

inputs.name: idWebhook
inputs.about: The unique identifier (ID) of the Trello webhook to retrieve.

tools.name: Get webhook field by id
tools.description: Gets a specific field's value from a Trello webhook, avoiding retrieval of the full webhook object.

inputs.name: field
inputs.about: The specific field to retrieve from the webhook object. Valid fields are: 'description', 'idModel', 'callbackURL', 'active', 'consecutiveFailures', 'firstConsecutiveFailDate'. Note: 'id' is NOT a valid field for this endpoint.

inputs.name: idWebhook
inputs.about: The unique identifier of the Trello webhook.

tools.name: List available emoji
tools.description: Tool to list all available emoji in Trello. Use when you need to browse or search for emoji to use in cards, comments, or reactions.

inputs.name: locale
inputs.about: The locale to return emoji descriptions and names in. Defaults to the logged in member's locale.

inputs.name: spritesheets
inputs.about: `true` to return spritesheet URLs in the response

tools.name: Mark all notifications as read
tools.description: Marks all Trello notifications for the authenticated user as read across all boards; this action is permanent and cannot be undone.

tools.name: Mark board as viewed
tools.description: Marks the Trello board specified by idBoard as viewed for the current user, exclusively updating its viewed status and potentially influencing its position in user-specific lists and notification settings.

inputs.name: idBoard
inputs.about: The unique identifier of the Trello board to be marked as viewed.

tools.name: Mark card notifications read
tools.description: Marks all notifications associated with a specific Trello card as read; this is irreversible and only affects read status, not deleting or modifying notifications.

inputs.name: idCard
inputs.about: The ID or short link of the card whose associated notifications are to be marked as read.

tools.name: Move all cards in list to another list
tools.description: Moves all cards from a source Trello list to a destination list on a specified board. This moves the cards rather than copying them.

inputs.name: idList
inputs.about: The ID of the source Trello list from which all cards will be moved. This is used in the path parameter.

inputs.name: idBoard
inputs.about: The ID of the destination Trello board to which all cards from the source list will be moved. This parameter is required by Trello for this operation.

inputs.name: idListDestination
inputs.about: The ID of the destination Trello list on the destination board to which all cards from the source list will be moved. This parameter is required by Trello for this operation.

tools.name: Delete member from board
tools.description: Permanently removes a current member from a Trello board, revoking their access; this action is irreversible.

inputs.name: idBoard
inputs.about: The ID of the board from which the member will be removed.

inputs.name: idMember
inputs.about: The ID of the member to remove from the board.

tools.name: Delete member board star
tools.description: Removes a specific starred board (identified by `idBoardStar`) from a Trello member's (identified by `idMember`) list of favorites; `idBoardStar` must be an existing star for that member.

inputs.name: idMember
inputs.about: The ID or username of the Trello member.

inputs.name: idBoardStar
inputs.about: The ID of the board star. This uniquely identifies the 'starred' relationship between the member and a board.

tools.name: Delete card label by color
tools.description: Permanently removes a specific `color` label from an existing Trello card identified by `idCard`, if the card has that label; this only disassociates the label from the card, not deleting the label definition itself.

inputs.name: color
inputs.about: The specific color of the label to remove from the card. Standard Trello label colors are used (e.g., 'red', 'blue').

inputs.name: idCard
inputs.about: The ID or short link of the Trello card.

tools.name: Remove label from card
tools.description: Removes a specific label from a Trello card; the label itself is not deleted from the board, only its association with the card.

inputs.name: idCard
inputs.about: The ID or short link of the card from which the label will be removed.

inputs.name: idLabel
inputs.about: The ID of the label to be removed from the card.

tools.name: Remove member from card
tools.description: Removes a currently assigned member from a Trello card, affecting only the card's member list and not the member's board membership or overall permissions.

inputs.name: idCard
inputs.about: The ID or shortLink of the card from which the member will be removed.

inputs.name: idMember
inputs.about: The ID of the member to be unassigned from the card.

tools.name: Delete member from organization
tools.description: Removes a member entirely from a specific Trello organization, including from all its boards and cards; this action is permanent and does not delete the member's Trello account.

inputs.name: idOrg
inputs.about: The ID or short name (slug) of the organization.

inputs.name: idMember
inputs.about: The ID of the member to remove from the organization.

tools.name: Set card custom field value
tools.description: Set one typed custom-field value on a Trello card.

inputs.name: date
inputs.about: ISO 8601 date-time to store for a date field. Provide exactly one value parameter.

inputs.name: text
inputs.about: Text to store for a text field. Provide exactly one of text, number, date, checked, or idValue.

inputs.name: idCard
inputs.about: The ID or short link of the Trello card.

inputs.name: number
inputs.about: Numeric string to store for a number field. Provide exactly one value parameter.

inputs.name: checked
inputs.about: State to store for a checkbox field. Provide exactly one value parameter.

inputs.name: idValue
inputs.about: Option ID to select for a list field. Provide exactly one value parameter.

inputs.name: idCustomField
inputs.about: The ID of the custom-field definition to set.

tools.name: Update action text
tools.description: Updates the `text` field of a specific Trello comment action, identified by `idAction`.

inputs.name: text
inputs.about: The new text content for the action (comment). Must be a string with a length from 1 to 16384 characters.

inputs.name: idAction
inputs.about: The unique identifier of the action (comment) to be updated.

tools.name: Update action text
tools.description: Updates the text of an existing Trello action (e.g., a comment or card update) identified by `idAction`; this change only affects the action's text content.

inputs.name: value
inputs.about: The new text content for the action. This string must have a length between 1 and 16384 characters, inclusive.

inputs.name: idAction
inputs.about: The unique identifier of the Trello action (e.g., a comment or card update) whose text needs to be updated.

tools.name: Update board membership
tools.description: Updates a user's role on a specific Trello board using board and membership IDs, with optional member fields in the response.

inputs.name: type
inputs.about: New role for the member on the board, determining their permissions. Must be 'admin', 'normal', or 'observer'.

inputs.name: idBoard
inputs.about: Unique identifier of the Trello board.

inputs.name: idMembership
inputs.about: Unique identifier of the membership to be updated.

inputs.name: member_fields
inputs.about: Fields for the member to include in the response. Use 'all' or a comma-separated list (e.g., avatarHash, bio, fullName).

tools.name: Update board by ID
tools.description: Updates attributes (e.g., name, description, status, preferences) of an existing Trello board identified by `idBoard`.

inputs.name: desc
inputs.about: New board description (max 16384 characters). An empty string removes the current description.

inputs.name: name
inputs.about: New name for the board (1-16384 characters).

inputs.name: closed
inputs.about: Set to 'true' to close (archive) the board, or 'false' to re-open.

inputs.name: idBoard
inputs.about: The ID of the Trello board to update.

inputs.name: powerUps
inputs.about: Power-Ups to enable (e.g., 'calendar,voting', 'all'). Valid: `calendar`, `cardAging`, `recap`, `voting`.

inputs.name: subscribed
inputs.about: 'true' or 'false' for the authenticated user to be subscribed to the board.

inputs.name: prefs_voting
inputs.about: Voting permissions. Maps to API parameter 'prefs_voting'. Allowed values: `disabled`, `members`, `observers`, `org`, `public`.

inputs.name: idBoardSource
inputs.about: ID of an existing board to copy settings (e.g., lists, labels) from.

inputs.name: prefs__voting
inputs.about: Voting permissions. Maps to API parameter 'prefs/voting'. Allowed values: `disabled`, `members`, `observers`, `org`, `public`.

inputs.name: idOrganization
inputs.about: ID or name of the Trello Workspace to associate with this board.

inputs.name: keepFromSource
inputs.about: Comma-separated components to copy from `idBoardSource` (e.g., 'cards,labels', 'all'). Defaults to 'cards' if `idBoardSource` is set. Valid: `cards`, `lists`, `members`, `checklists`, `comments`, `labels`, `stickers`, `attachments`.

inputs.name: prefs_comments
inputs.about: Commenting permissions. Maps to API parameter 'prefs_comments'. Allowed values: `disabled`, `members`, `observers`, `org`, `public`.

inputs.name: prefs_selfJoin
inputs.about: Enables or disables self-join for Workspace members. Maps to API parameter 'prefs_selfJoin'. Set to 'true' or 'false'.

inputs.name: labelNames__red
inputs.about: Custom name for the red label (max 16384 chars). Maps to API parameter 'labelNames/red'.

inputs.name: prefs__comments
inputs.about: Commenting permissions. Maps to API parameter 'prefs/comments'. Allowed values: `disabled`, `members`, `observers`, `org`, `public`.

inputs.name: prefs__selfJoin
inputs.about: Enable or disable self-join for Workspace members. Maps to API parameter 'prefs/selfJoin'. Set to 'true' or 'false'.

inputs.name: prefs_cardAging
inputs.about: Card aging style. Maps to API parameter 'prefs_cardAging'. Allowed values: `pirate`, `regular`.

inputs.name: labelNames__blue
inputs.about: Custom name for the blue label (max 16384 chars). Maps to API parameter 'labelNames/blue'.

inputs.name: prefs__cardAging
inputs.about: Card aging style. Maps to API parameter 'prefs/cardAging'. Allowed values: `pirate`, `regular`.

inputs.name: prefs_background
inputs.about: Board background. Maps to API parameter 'prefs_background'. Can be a color name, a custom background ID, or a Trello photo ID. Max length: 16384 characters.

inputs.name: prefs_cardCovers
inputs.about: Enables or disables card covers. Maps to API parameter 'prefs_cardCovers'. Set to 'true' or 'false'.

inputs.name: labelNames__green
inputs.about: Custom name for the green label (max 16384 chars). Maps to API parameter 'labelNames/green'.

inputs.name: prefs__background
inputs.about: Board background. Maps to API parameter 'prefs/background'. Use a standard Trello background name (e.g., 'blue', 'orange', 'green', 'red', 'purple', 'pink', 'lime', 'sky', 'grey') or the ID of a custom background image.

inputs.name: prefs__cardCovers
inputs.about: Enable or disable card covers. Maps to API parameter 'prefs/cardCovers'. Set to 'true' or 'false'.

inputs.name: prefs_invitations
inputs.about: Invitation permissions. Maps to API parameter 'prefs_invitations'. Allowed values: `admins`, `members`.

inputs.name: labelNames__orange
inputs.about: Custom name for the orange label (max 16384 chars). Maps to API parameter 'labelNames/orange'.

inputs.name: labelNames__purple
inputs.about: Custom name for the purple label (max 16384 chars). Maps to API parameter 'labelNames/purple'.

inputs.name: labelNames__yellow
inputs.about: Custom name for the yellow label (max 16384 chars). Maps to API parameter 'labelNames/yellow'.

inputs.name: prefs__invitations
inputs.about: Invitation permissions. Maps to API parameter 'prefs/invitations'. Allowed values: `admins`, `members`.

inputs.name: prefs_permissionLevel
inputs.about: Board's visibility and permission level. Maps to API parameter 'prefs_permissionLevel'. Allowed values: `org`, `private`, `public`.

inputs.name: prefs__permissionLevel
inputs.about: Board visibility and permission level. Maps to API parameter 'prefs/permissionLevel'. Allowed values: `org` (Workspace-visible), `private`, `public`.

inputs.name: prefs__calendarFeedEnabled
inputs.about: Enable or disable the iCalendar feed. Maps to API parameter 'prefs/calendarFeedEnabled'. Set to 'true' or 'false'.

tools.name: Update board closed status
tools.description: Archives (closes) an active Trello board or reopens a previously archived board.

inputs.name: value
inputs.about: The desired closed state for the board. Set to the string 'true' to close (archive) the board, or the string 'false' to reopen it.

inputs.name: idBoard
inputs.about: The ID of the Trello board to be updated.

tools.name: Update board description
tools.description: Updates the description of a specified Trello board; the update is immediate and does not affect other board elements like lists, cards, or membership.

inputs.name: value
inputs.about: The new description for the board. Must be a string with a length between 0 and 16384 characters. Providing an empty string ("") will clear the board's description. If `null` is sent or the field is omitted, Trello's behavior might vary, potentially leaving the description unchanged or clearing it;

inputs.name: idBoard
inputs.about: The unique identifier of the Trello board whose description will be updated.

tools.name: Update board sidebar actions preferences
tools.description: Updates the current user's preference for the visibility of sidebar board actions on a specific Trello board.

inputs.name: value
inputs.about: Controls the visibility of sidebar board actions. Use 'true' to show them, 'false' to hide them.

inputs.name: idBoard
inputs.about: The unique identifier of the Trello board for which the 'showSidebarBoardActions' preference is being updated.

tools.name: Update my board sidebar activity preference
tools.description: Sets the current user's preference for displaying or concealing the sidebar activity feed on an accessible Trello board; this change only affects the requesting user.

inputs.name: value
inputs.about: Determines the visibility of the sidebar activity. Set to 'true' to show the activity feed, or 'false' to hide it.

inputs.name: idBoard
inputs.about: The unique identifier of the Trello board whose sidebar activity visibility preference is to be updated.

tools.name: Update board sidebar members preference
tools.description: Updates the authenticated user's preference for showing or hiding members in a specific Trello board's sidebar, affecting only the current user's view.

inputs.name: value
inputs.about: Determines whether to show members in the board sidebar. Set to 'true' to show members, or 'false' to hide them. This is a per-user preference.

inputs.name: idBoard
inputs.about: The unique identifier of the Trello board for which the sidebar member visibility preference will be updated.

tools.name: Update board organization
tools.description: Moves an existing Trello board to a specified, existing Trello organization, which can affect the board's visibility and member access.

inputs.name: value
inputs.about: The ID of the new Trello organization to which the board will be moved. Must be a string with a length between 0 and 16384 characters. An empty string may be used to attempt to remove the board from its current organization, if the Trello API supports this behavior.

inputs.name: idBoard
inputs.about: The ID of the Trello board to be moved to a new organization.

tools.name: Update a board's blue label name
tools.description: Sets the name of the blue label for a Trello board.

inputs.name: value
inputs.about: The new name for the blue label. Must be a string with a length from 0 to 16384 characters. An empty string can be used to remove the current name.

inputs.name: idBoard
inputs.about: The unique identifier of the Trello board whose blue label name is to be updated.

tools.name: Update board's green label name
tools.description: Updates the name of the green label for a specified Trello board; this change is board-wide, affects all cards using this label, and does not change the label's color.

inputs.name: value
inputs.about: The new name for the green label (0-16384 characters). An empty string may reset the name or cause an error.

inputs.name: idBoard
inputs.about: The ID of the Trello board for which the green label name will be updated.

tools.name: Update board label orange name
tools.description: Updates the name of the first orange label returned for a specified Trello board. If no orange label is found, the action fails; an omitted name defaults to an empty string.

inputs.name: value
inputs.about: The new name for the orange label. It must be a string with a length from 0 to 16384 characters. An empty string will remove the current custom name.

inputs.name: idBoard
inputs.about: The unique identifier of the Trello board whose orange label name is to be updated.

tools.name: Update purple label name
tools.description: Updates the name of the first purple label returned for a Trello board. If no purple label is found, the action fails; an omitted name defaults to an empty string.

inputs.name: value
inputs.about: The new name to be assigned to the purple label. This string must have a length between 0 and 16384 characters. An empty string can be used to clear the existing custom name.

inputs.name: idBoard
inputs.about: The unique identifier of the Trello board where the purple label's name will be updated.

tools.name: Update red label name
tools.description: Updates the name of the first red label returned for a Trello board. If no red label is found, the action fails; an omitted name defaults to an empty string.

inputs.name: value
inputs.about: The new name to be assigned to the red label. This string must have a length between 0 and 16384 characters. An empty string can be used to clear the existing custom name.

inputs.name: idBoard
inputs.about: The unique identifier of the Trello board where the red label's name will be updated.

tools.name: Update yellow label name on board
tools.description: Updates the name of a board's yellow label; other colored labels are unaffected.

inputs.name: value
inputs.about: The new name for the yellow label. Must be a string with a length between 0 and 16384 characters. An empty string ("") will remove the current name of the label.

inputs.name: idBoard
inputs.about: The ID of the Trello board where the yellow label name will be updated.

tools.name: Update board members
tools.description: Adds or updates a member's role on a specific Trello board, typically requiring the member's `email` and a membership `type`.

inputs.name: type
inputs.about: Role to assign to the member on the board, determining permissions. Typically required by Trello.

inputs.name: email
inputs.about: Email address of the user to add or update. Typically required by Trello.

inputs.name: idBoard
inputs.about: The unique identifier of the Trello board.

inputs.name: fullName
inputs.about: Full name for a new user invitation; must be >=1 character and no leading/trailing spaces.

tools.name: Update board member attributes
tools.description: Updates a member's role on a specific Trello board using the board and member IDs.

inputs.name: type
inputs.about: New role for the member on this board, determining their permissions.

inputs.name: email
inputs.about: New board-specific email address for the member; does not change their global Trello account email.

inputs.name: idBoard
inputs.about: ID of the board.

inputs.name: fullName
inputs.about: New board-specific full name for the member; must be >=1 character and not start/end with a space.

inputs.name: idMember
inputs.about: ID of the member to update.

tools.name: Modify board email position preference
tools.description: Updates a Trello board's email position preference for new cards; this preference only affects new cards (not existing ones) and the board must exist.

inputs.name: value
inputs.about: Position where new cards created via email will be placed in the list. Valid values are 'top' (card appears at the top of the list) or 'bottom' (card appears at the bottom of the list).

inputs.name: idBoard
inputs.about: The unique identifier of the Trello board for which to update the email position preference.

tools.name: Update board email list preference
tools.description: Sets the default Trello list where cards created via email will be added for a specific board.

inputs.name: value
inputs.about: ID of an existing list on the board where cards created via email will be added. Must be a valid list ID that belongs to this board.

inputs.name: idBoard
inputs.about: ID of the board whose email-to-list preference will be updated.

tools.name: Update board show list guide preference
tools.description: DEPRECATED: Updates the 'Show List Guide' preference for a specified Trello board. WARNING: This endpoint has been deprecated by Trello (CHANGE-2651, June 2025) and returns 'Cannot PUT' errors. The showListGuide preference is no longer actively used in Trello's application. While the preference still appears in GET /boards/{id}/myPrefs responses, the PUT endpoint for updating it has been removed from Trello's API. Consider using other board preference endpoints like showSidebar, showSidebarActivity, showSidebarMembers, or showSidebarBoardActions which remain functional.

inputs.name: value
inputs.about: Determines whether the list guide is shown; use 'true' to display or 'false' to hide.

inputs.name: idBoard
inputs.about: The unique identifier of the Trello board.

tools.name: Update board sidebar visibility
tools.description: Updates the authenticated user's personal preference for showing or hiding the sidebar on a specific Trello board.

inputs.name: value
inputs.about: Boolean string to control sidebar visibility. Set to 'true' to show the sidebar, or 'false' to hide it.

inputs.name: idBoard
