tools.description: Updates the avatar source for a specified Trello member. The avatar source determines which image is displayed as the member's profile picture: Gravatar (based on email), a previously uploaded custom image, or the default initials avatar. Note: This endpoint requires write permissions for member profiles.

inputs.name: value
inputs.about: The avatar source to use for the member's profile image. 'gravatar' uses the Gravatar service based on the member's email. 'upload' displays a previously uploaded custom avatar (must upload first via separate endpoint). 'none' shows the default initials-based avatar.

inputs.name: idMember
inputs.about: The ID or username of the Trello member whose avatar source is to be updated. Use 'me' to refer to the authenticated user.

tools.name: Update member bio
tools.description: Updates the bio/description of a specified Trello member. The bio is a short text that appears on the member's profile. Requires write permissions for the member's account.

inputs.name: value
inputs.about: The new bio content for the member. This can be an empty string or a string with a maximum length of 16,384 characters.

inputs.name: idMember
inputs.about: The ID or username of the Trello member whose bio is to be updated. Use 'me' to refer to the authenticated user.

tools.name: Update Member Board Background
tools.description: Update Member Board Background

inputs.name: file
inputs.about: Base64-encoded image data to replace the board background image. Only applicable for custom backgrounds. This parameter is rarely needed since most updates use brightness and tile properties.

inputs.name: tile
inputs.about: Determines if the board background image should be tiled. Set to 'true' to tile the image, or 'false' to display it normally.

inputs.name: idMember
inputs.about: The ID or username of the Trello member whose board background is being updated. Use 'me' for the authenticated user.

inputs.name: brightness
inputs.about: Adjusts the brightness of the board background. Valid values are 'dark', 'light', or 'unknown'.

inputs.name: idBoardBackground
inputs.about: The ID of the existing board background to be updated. This identifier specifies which of the member's board backgrounds will be modified.

tools.name: Update Member Board Star
tools.description: Update Member Board Star

inputs.name: pos
inputs.about: New position for the board star ('top', 'bottom', or a positive number string like '1' or '1024.5'). 'top' is first, 'bottom' is last.

inputs.name: idBoard
inputs.about: ID of the Trello board this star should point to; if provided, updates the star's reference.

inputs.name: idMember
inputs.about: ID or username of the Trello member.

inputs.name: idBoardStar
inputs.about: Unique ID of the board star to update (not the board ID it points to).

tools.name: Update member by ID
tools.description: Updates an existing Trello member's profile information, preferences, or username.

inputs.name: bio
inputs.about: Biography (0-16384 characters).

inputs.name: fullName
inputs.about: Full name (at least 1 character; no leading/trailing spaces).

inputs.name: idMember
inputs.about: The ID or username of the Trello member to update.

inputs.name: initials
inputs.about: Initials (1-4 characters; no leading/trailing spaces).

inputs.name: username
inputs.about: Desired username (at least 3 characters; lowercase letters, underscores, numbers only; must be unique).

inputs.name: avatarSource
inputs.about: Source for the member's avatar. Valid values: 'gravatar', 'none', 'upload'.

inputs.name: prefs__locale
inputs.about: Preferred locale (0-255 characters).

inputs.name: prefs__colorBlind
inputs.about: Toggle color blind mode. Valid values: 'true', 'false'.

inputs.name: prefs__minutesBetweenSummaries
inputs.about: Time between email summaries. Valid values: '-1' (disabled), '1' (every minute), '60' (every hour).

tools.name: Update member's custom board background
tools.description: Update member's custom board background

inputs.name: file
inputs.about: The new image file (URL or path) for the background.

inputs.name: tile
inputs.about: Whether the background image should be tiled ('true' or 'false').

inputs.name: idMember
inputs.about: The ID or username of the Trello member. Use 'me' for the authenticated user.

inputs.name: brightness
inputs.about: Sets the brightness for the background ('dark', 'light', or 'unknown').

inputs.name: idBoardBackground
inputs.about: The ID of the specific custom board background to update.

tools.name: Update member full name by id
tools.description: Updates the full name for a Trello member, identified by their valid ID or username; this operation only affects the full name, leaving other profile information unchanged.

inputs.name: value
inputs.about: The new full name for the member. Must be a string with a length of at least 1 and cannot begin or end with a space.

inputs.name: idMember
inputs.about: The ID or username of the Trello member whose full name is to be updated.

tools.name: Update member initials
tools.description: Updates the initials for a specified Trello member, identified by their ID or username.

inputs.name: value
inputs.about: New initials (1-4 characters, no leading/trailing spaces). If omitted or an empty string is provided, Trello may clear the member's current initials.

inputs.name: idMember
inputs.about: ID or username of the Trello member.

tools.name: Update member color blind preference
tools.description: Updates a Trello member's color blind friendly mode preference. When enabled, labels display patterns in addition to colors to help users who have difficulty distinguishing colors. This setting only affects the authenticated member's view and does not change how other members see the board.

inputs.name: value
inputs.about: The desired state for the color blind preference. Must be 'true' to enable color blind friendly mode (adds patterns to labels), or 'false' to disable it.

inputs.name: idMember
inputs.about: The ID or username of the Trello member whose color blind preference will be updated. Use 'me' to update the authenticated user's preference.

tools.name: Update member locale preference
tools.description: Updates a Trello member's locale preference to change how dates, times, and numbers are displayed in the Trello UI. Requires 'account' scope in the API token. Use 'me' as idMember to update the authenticated user's locale.

inputs.name: value
inputs.about: The locale code to set for the member (e.g., 'en-US', 'fr-FR'). Must be a valid IETF language tag. This affects how dates, times, and numbers are displayed in the Trello UI for this member.

inputs.name: idMember
inputs.about: The ID or username of the Trello member whose locale preference will be updated. Use 'me' to refer to the authenticated user.

tools.name: Update Member Summary Interval
tools.description: Updates a Trello member's preference for the frequency of email summary notifications; this setting affects only summary notifications.

inputs.name: value
inputs.about: The interval in minutes between email summary notifications. Use '-1' to disable summaries entirely, '1' for notifications every minute, or '60' for hourly summaries. Common values: -1 (disabled), 1 (every minute), 60 (hourly).

inputs.name: idMember
inputs.about: The ID or username of the Trello member whose summary notification interval will be updated. Use 'me' to update the authenticated user's preference.

tools.name: Update member saved search
tools.description: Update member saved search

inputs.name: pos
inputs.about: The new position for the saved search. Valid values are 'top', 'bottom', or a positive numeric string (e.g., '1', '2').

inputs.name: name
inputs.about: The new name for the saved search. Must be a non-empty string containing at least one non-space character.

inputs.name: query
inputs.about: The new search query string. Must be a string with a length between 1 and 16384 characters, inclusive.

inputs.name: idMember
inputs.about: The ID or username of the Trello member. Use 'me' to refer to the authenticated user.

inputs.name: idSavedSearch
inputs.about: The ID of the saved search to be updated.

tools.name: Update member saved search name
tools.description: Update member saved search name

inputs.name: value
inputs.about: The new name to be assigned to the saved search. Must be a non-empty string with at least one non-space character.

inputs.name: idMember
inputs.about: The ID or username of the Trello member whose saved search is being updated. Use 'me' to refer to the authenticated user.

inputs.name: idSavedSearch
inputs.about: The ID of the saved search to be renamed. This is a 24-character hexadecimal string that can be obtained from the 'get_members_saved_searches_by_id_member' action.

tools.name: Update member saved search position
tools.description: Update member saved search position

inputs.name: value
inputs.about: The new position for the saved search. Accepts 'top' to move to first position, 'bottom' to move to last position, or a positive integer (as a string) representing the desired numeric position.

inputs.name: idMember
inputs.about: The ID or username of the Trello member. Use 'me' to refer to the authenticated user.

inputs.name: idSavedSearch
inputs.about: The 24-character hexadecimal ID of the saved search to be repositioned. Obtain this ID from the get_members_saved_searches_by_id_member action.

tools.name: Update member saved search query
tools.description: Update member saved search query

inputs.name: value
inputs.about: The new query string for the saved search, defining the search criteria using Trello's search syntax. Must be 1 to 16384 characters. Supports operators like is:open, label:, due:, board:, list:, @member, etc.

inputs.name: idMember
inputs.about: The ID or username of the Trello member whose saved search will be updated. Use 'me' for the authenticated user, or provide a 24-character hex member ID or username.

inputs.name: idSavedSearch
inputs.about: The unique 24-character hexadecimal identifier of the saved search to update. Obtain this ID from the GET /members/{idMember}/savedSearches endpoint.

tools.name: Update member username
tools.description: Updates the username for an existing Trello member, identified by their ID or current username. IMPORTANT: This endpoint requires an authentication token (web session), not an API consent token. Third-party applications using API tokens cannot update member profile fields (username, fullName, initials, locale) - this is a Trello security restriction to ensure only members can modify their own profile data directly.

inputs.name: value
inputs.about: The new username for the member. Must be at least 3 characters long, unique across all Trello users, and contain only lowercase letters, numbers, and underscores.

inputs.name: idMember
inputs.about: The ID or current username of the Trello member whose username is to be updated.

tools.name: Update notification status by id
tools.description: Updates only the 'unread' status of a specific Trello notification.

inputs.name: unread
inputs.about: A string indicating the desired unread status. Set to 'true' to mark the notification as unread, or 'false' to mark it as read.

inputs.name: idNotification
inputs.about: The unique identifier (ID) of the Trello notification to update. This is a 24-character hexadecimal string. You can obtain notification IDs by using the 'get_members_notifications_by_id_member' action.

tools.name: Update notification unread status
tools.description: Updates the unread status of a specific Trello notification. Use this action to mark notifications as read (value='false') or unread (value='true'). The notification must belong to the authenticated user. To get notification IDs, use the 'get_members_notifications_by_id_member' action first.

inputs.name: value
inputs.about: The new unread status for the notification. Set to 'true' to mark the notification as unread, or 'false' to mark it as read. If not specified, the notification will be marked as read (unread=false).

inputs.name: idNotification
inputs.about: The unique identifier (ID) of the Trello notification to update. This is a 24-character hexadecimal string. You can obtain notification IDs by using the 'get_members_notifications_by_id_member' action with idMember='me'.

tools.name: Add organization logo
tools.description: Sets or updates the logo for a Trello organization; the provided image file must adhere to Trello's format and size restrictions.

inputs.name: file
inputs.about: The logo image file to upload. Supported formats: PNG, JPEG, GIF. Must be a valid image file.

inputs.name: idOrg
inputs.about: ID or unique name of the Trello organization.

tools.name: Update organization attributes
tools.description: Updates various attributes of an existing Trello organization, identified by `idOrg`.

inputs.name: desc
inputs.about: New description for the organization (0-16384 characters).

inputs.name: name
inputs.about: New name for the organization (0-16384 characters); typically lowercase, without spaces.

inputs.name: idOrg
inputs.about: The ID or name of the organization to update.

inputs.name: website
inputs.about: The organization's website URL. Must start with 'http://' or 'https://'. Use the literal string 'null' or an empty string to remove the website.

inputs.name: displayName
inputs.about: New display name for the organization (length of at least 1, cannot begin or end with a space).

inputs.name: prefs__permissionLevel
inputs.about: Sets the default permission level for new boards created in the organization. Valid values: 'private' or 'public'.

inputs.name: prefs__associatedDomain
inputs.about: The Google Workspace domain to associate with the organization (e.g., 'example.com'). Clears the domain if an empty string is provided.

inputs.name: prefs__googleAppsVersion
inputs.about: The version of Google Workspace integration. Valid values are '1' or '2'.

inputs.name: prefs__orgInviteRestrict
inputs.about: Restricts organization membership invitations to email addresses from specified domains. Use a comma-separated list of domains (e.g., 'example.com,*.example.org'). An empty string removes restrictions.

inputs.name: prefs__externalMembersDisabled
inputs.about: Set to 'true' to prevent external members (guests) from being added to boards within the organization. Set to 'false' to allow external members.

inputs.name: prefs__boardVisibilityRestrict__org
inputs.about: Controls who can create organization-visible boards. Valid values: 'admin' (only admins), 'org' (any organization member), 'none' (disabled).

inputs.name: prefs__boardVisibilityRestrict__public
inputs.about: Controls who can create public boards. Valid values: 'admin' (only admins), 'org' (any organization member), 'none' (disabled).

inputs.name: prefs__boardVisibilityRestrict__private
inputs.about: Controls who can create private boards. Valid values: 'admin' (only admins), 'org' (any organization member), 'none' (disabled).

tools.name: Update organization description
tools.description: Updates or clears the description for an existing Trello organization, identified by its ID or name, to a new string up to 16384 characters.

inputs.name: idOrg
inputs.about: The ID or name of the organization whose description is to be updated. This can be the organization's unique 24-character hexadecimal ID or its registered name.

inputs.name: value
inputs.about: The new description for the organization. Must be a string with a length between 0 and 16384 characters. An empty string can be used to clear the existing description.

tools.name: Update organization display name
tools.description: Updates the display name of a Trello organization, identifiable by its current ID or name (`idOrg`), to the new `value`; other attributes remain unaffected.

inputs.name: idOrg
inputs.about: The ID or current name of the Trello organization to update.

inputs.name: value
inputs.about: The new display name for the organization. Required. Must be at least 1 character and cannot begin or end with a space.

tools.name: Update an organization member
tools.description: Adds/updates a member in a specified Trello organization (`idOrg`); `email` and `type` are API-required, `fullName` is needed if `email` is new to Trello.

inputs.name: type
inputs.about: Membership type determining the member's permissions within the organization; required by Trello API.

inputs.name: email
inputs.about: Member's email address; used to identify an existing member or invite/add a new one. Required by the Trello API.

inputs.name: idOrg
inputs.about: ID or name of the Trello organization (Workspace).

inputs.name: fullName
inputs.about: Member's full name. Used when inviting a new member; required if `email` isn't linked to an existing Trello account. Must be >=1 character and not start/end with a space.

tools.name: Update organization member
tools.description: Updates a member's role/type (admin, normal, or observer) in a Trello organization. Note: This operation requires a premium Trello workspace - free workspaces cannot change memberships.

inputs.name: type
inputs.about: The new membership type/role for the member in this organization. Determines permissions: 'admin' has full control, 'normal' is a standard member, 'observer' has read-only access. Note: Requires a premium workspace to change membership types.

inputs.name: idOrg
inputs.about: The ID or name of the Trello organization (workspace). Can be the 24-character hex ID or the organization's short name.

inputs.name: idMember
inputs.about: The 24-character hex ID of the member whose role in the organization should be updated.

tools.name: Update org member deactivation status
tools.description: Update org member deactivation status

inputs.name: idOrg
inputs.about: The ID or name of the Trello organization (workspace). Example: '5a7e5c9e4a5a8c0f2a7b6c3d' or 'myworkspace'.

inputs.name: value
inputs.about: Required. Set to 'true' to deactivate the member (suspend their access temporarily) or 'false' to reactivate them.

inputs.name: idMember
inputs.about: The ID of the member whose deactivation status is to be updated. Note: You cannot deactivate yourself. Example: '5a7e5c9e4a5a8c0f2a7b6c3e'.

tools.name: Update org membership
tools.description: Update org membership

inputs.name: type
inputs.about: The new type for the membership. Valid values are 'admin', 'normal', or 'observer'.

inputs.name: idOrg
inputs.about: The ID or name of the Trello organization.

inputs.name: idMembership
inputs.about: The ID of the specific membership to be updated.

inputs.name: member_fields
inputs.about: Member fields to return in the response. Use 'all' or a comma-separated list: avatarHash, bio, bioData, confirmed, fullName, idPremOrgsAdmin, initials, memberType, products, status, url, username.

tools.name: Update organization name by id
tools.description: Updates the unique programmatic identifier (used in URLs and API interactions) for an existing Trello organization; this is an irreversible operation, effective immediately, and only affects this identifier.

inputs.name: idOrg
inputs.about: The ID or current name of the Trello organization whose name is to be updated.

inputs.name: value
inputs.about: The new name for the organization. It must be unique, at least 3 characters long, and contain only lowercase letters, underscores, and numbers.

tools.name: Update an organization's associated domain preferences
tools.description: Update an organization's associated domain preferences

inputs.name: idOrg
inputs.about: The ID or name of the organization to update. This organization must exist.

inputs.name: value
inputs.about: The Google Workspace domain to link to this organization (e.g., 'example.com'). If an empty string is provided, the existing associated domain will be removed. The domain should be a valid, existing Google Workspace domain.

tools.name: Update organization board visibility preference
tools.description: Updates the preference controlling who can set board visibility to 'organization-visible' within an existing Trello organization.

inputs.name: idOrg
inputs.about: The ID or unique name of the Trello organization for which to update the board visibility restriction.

inputs.name: value
inputs.about:
Specifies the permission level for setting a board's visibility to 'organization-visible'.
Allowed values are:

*   `none`: No specific restriction; board members with appropriate permissions can set its visibilit

tools.name: Update an organization's external members access
tools.description: Update an organization's external members access

inputs.name: idOrg
inputs.about: The ID or unique name of the Trello organization to update.

inputs.name: value
inputs.about: Boolean value to set the 'externalMembersDisabled' preference. 'true' disables adding external members, 'false' enables it.

tools.name: Update organization permission level
tools.description: Updates a Trello organization's `permissionLevel` preference, determining if it's members-only or link-accessible, and affecting new board default visibility.

inputs.name: idOrg
inputs.about: The ID or unique name of the Trello organization (Workspace). For example, 'trelloorg123' or 'MyTrelloOrganizationName'.

inputs.name: value
inputs.about: The new permission level for the organization. Must be either 'private' or 'public'.

tools.name: Update organization private board visibility restriction
tools.description: Update organization private board visibility restriction

inputs.name: idOrg
inputs.about: The unique ID (e.g., '605c72ef2f849a001c2f3a4b') or short name (e.g., 'myorganization') of the Trello organization whose private board visibility restrictions are to be updated.

inputs.name: value
inputs.about: Restriction level determining who can create or change visibility of private boards within the organization. Valid values: 'admin' (only admins can create private boards), 'org' (any organization member can create private boards), 'none' (private boards are disabled).

tools.name: Update organization public board visibility
tools.description: Update organization public board visibility

inputs.name: idOrg
inputs.about: The ID or name of the Trello organization.

inputs.name: value
inputs.about: Specifies the restriction level for setting board visibility to public. Valid values are 'admin' (only administrators can set boards to public), 'org' (any member of the organization can set boards to public), or 'none' (public boards are disabled for the organization).

tools.name: Update organization website
tools.description: Updates the website URL for a specified Trello organization.

inputs.name: idOrg
inputs.about: The ID or name of the organization to update.

inputs.name: value
inputs.about: The new website URL for the organization. Must start with 'http://' or 'https://'. Provide 'null' or an empty string to remove the website.

tools.name: Update organization Google Apps version
tools.description: Updates the Google Apps integration version preference for a specified Trello organization, to manage compatibility or features related to Google Workspace services.

inputs.name: idOrg
inputs.about: The ID or name of the Trello organization to update.

inputs.name: value
inputs.about: The Google Apps version (typically '1' or '2') to set for the organization, representing different integration versions or configurations.

tools.name: Update organization invite restriction
tools.description: Adds an email domain restriction to a Trello organization's invitation policy. Members can only be invited if their email matches the specified domain. This is an Enterprise-only feature requiring admin privileges on the organization.

inputs.name: idOrg
inputs.about: The unique identifier (ID) or name of the Trello organization (workspace). Note: This endpoint requires Trello Enterprise with admin privileges.

inputs.name: value
inputs.about: The email domain restriction to add for organization invitations. Must be a valid email domain (e.g., 'example.com') that members must have to be invited to the organization. Requires Trello Enterprise.

tools.name: Update session by id
tools.description: Updates a Trello user session's viewed board ID or status; call when user activity or board focus changes.

inputs.name: status
inputs.about: The new status of the session. Valid values are 'active', 'disconnected', or 'idle'.

inputs.name: idBoard
inputs.about: The ID of the Trello board the user is currently viewing.

inputs.name: idSession
inputs.about: The unique identifier of the session to be updated.

tools.name: Update session status by ID
tools.description: Updates the status of an existing Trello session. IMPORTANT: This endpoint is part of Trello's internal/deprecated session API. WebSocket connections via API key+token were deprecated on November 15, 2024. This endpoint may not be accessible via standard API authentication. Use this to update a session's activity status (active/idle/disconnected) for real-time presence tracking in Trello boards.

inputs.name: value
inputs.about: The new status to set for the session. Accepted values: 'active' (user is actively using Trello), 'idle' (user is away/inactive), 'disconnected' (session ended).

inputs.name: idSession
inputs.about: The unique identifier of the Trello session whose status is to be updated. Session IDs are obtained when creating a session via POST /sessions.

tools.name: Update webhook active status
tools.description: Updates the active status of an existing Trello webhook. Set `value` to 'true' to activate the webhook (enable notifications) or 'false' to deactivate it (pause notifications). The webhook's other properties (callbackURL, idModel, description) remain unchanged.

inputs.name: value
inputs.about: The desired active state for the webhook. Must be 'true' to activate or 'false' to deactivate.

inputs.name: idWebhook
inputs.about: The unique 24-character hexadecimal identifier of the webhook to update.

tools.name: Update webhooks
tools.description: Updates an existing Trello webhook's description, active status, callback URL, or monitored model ID; requires the webhook ID (not in request body) to be specified, typically via URL path.

inputs.name: active
inputs.about: Indicates if the webhook is active (true) or inactive (false).

inputs.name: idModel
inputs.about: ID of the Trello model (e.g., board, card, list) the webhook should monitor.

inputs.name: idWebhook
inputs.about: The ID of the webhook to update.

inputs.name: callbackURL
inputs.about: New valid URL for POST requests; Trello verifies with a HEAD request before updating.

inputs.name: description
inputs.about: New description for the webhook (0-16384 characters).

tools.name: Update webhook callback url
tools.description: Updates the callback URL for a specific Trello webhook; other webhook attributes remain unchanged.

inputs.name: value
inputs.about: A valid URL that Trello will send a HEAD request to verify. This URL will receive webhook notifications.

inputs.name: idWebhook
inputs.about: The ID of the webhook to update.

tools.name: Update webhook description
tools.description: Updates the description of an existing Trello webhook; an empty string for the new description removes the current one.

inputs.name: value
inputs.about: The new description for the webhook. Must be a string with a length between 0 and 16384 characters. An empty string will remove the existing description.

inputs.name: idWebhook
inputs.about: The unique identifier of the webhook whose description is to be updated.

tools.name: Update webhook idModel
tools.description: Updates the `idModel` (the monitored Trello entity like a board, list, or card) for an active webhook `idWebhook` to the new model ID `value`; other webhook properties are unaffected.

inputs.name: value
inputs.about: The new ID of the Trello model (e.g., board, list, or card) that the webhook should monitor. This ID will replace the webhook's current `idModel`. Must be a valid 24-character Trello object ID.

inputs.name: idWebhook
inputs.about: The unique identifier of the webhook whose monitored model is to be updated. This ID is part of the request URL path.

tools.name: Who Am I
tools.description: Return the identity (username, email) of the connected Trello account.
